snippet.title: Land of Anima: The Research of Artificer Demo v1 - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Land of Anima: The Research of Artificer is a Isometric tower defense game where you can change the map routes to create your own strategy. Collect resources, craft towers, and upgrade your equipment to unravel the mysteries of the Land of Anima.

Land of Anima: The Research of Artificer es un juego de defensa de torres isométrico donde puedes modificar las rutas del mapa para crear tu propia estrategia. Recolecta recursos, construye torres y mejora tu equipo para desentrañar los misterios de la Tierra de Anima.

➤➤ Links
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3702950/Land_of_Anima_The_Research_of_Artificer/

Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3733530/Land_of_Anima_The_Research_of_Artificer_Demo/

X: https://twitter.com/NHS_Projects/

-----------------------------------------------------------
#indiegame #steamgame #steam #roguelite #trailer #games #gaming #towerdefense  #rpg #landofanima #isometric #demo #steamnextfest 

We are NHS_Projects, indie developers.

Creators of -Land of Anima: Origin of Union, a wave-based survival roguelite game with casual fantasy and RPG elements-

Currently developing -Land of Anima: The Research of Artificer, an isometric tower defense game whit management, crafting, strategy and RPG elements.-

For now we only develop PC games for Steam.
-----------------------------------------------------------
